deck_title: Heidrich-Seidel dual-paraboloid conformal reflection mapping vs single-sphere map pole pinch rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Wolfgang Heidrich & Hans-Peter Seidel (Eurographics / SIGGRAPH 1998) Dual-Paraboloid stereographic environment reflection mapping (u_DP = R_xy / (1 + |R_z|), locking conformal anisotropy condition number kappa_DP = s_phi / s_theta = 1.0000x across front and back hemispheres) versus classic Blinn-Newell / MatCap single-sphere reflection mapping (u_Sph = R_xy / sqrt(2(1 + R_z)), suffering azimuthal pinch distortion kappa_Sph = 2 / (1 + mu)) and 64-substep differential stereographic metric integration across 17 zenith cosine stations (mu in [+1.0000, -0.6000]).
